candidate: Mitsui Fudosan (仮称)日野市日野台3丁目計画 data-centre development, Hino, Tokyo
provenance: Registration first prepared on 2026-10-17 by the unpublished japan_east research lane (lane copy tmp/research-2026-10-17-east/japan_east/geometry-facts-hino.json; that addition was retired because its status source fell outside the window). Re-derived on 2026-10-27 for jp-kanto-pref-p5 from the recorded control points and traced outline (script work/geo/hino_verify.py): the similarity fit, polygon, area, selected point and clearance reproduce exactly; the developer PDF re-captured on 2026-10-27 is byte-identical (sha256 96176bfc...); all 98 GSI z18 tiles in the two manifests rehash to their recorded sha256; and the GSI standard tile containing the marker (18/232563/103233), re-fetched on 2026-10-27, is byte-identical to the manifest copy.
selected_point_role: parent-property marker inside the 114,037 m² development site (former Hino Motors west plant) outlined on the developer's site plan; not a building, a data hall, a surveyed boundary or a construction extent

source_map.embedded_image: 1533x1079 px raster (pdfimages page 8 object 177) carrying a planimetric base map with the red site outline, three planned buildings and labelled neighbours (日野台公園, はくちょう学園, 多摩小ばと保育園, 甲州街道(16m))
source_map.north_arrow: overlay arrow rotated about 20 degrees clockwise from page-up

registration.transform: least-squares 2D similarity (rotation, uniform scale, translation) from six control points; no area forcing
registration.notes: Control points: centres of the two circular tanks drawn on both the source base map and the GSI standard map north-east of the site; the four corners of the 日野台公園 block west of the site. The site's south-west corner on 甲州街道 was held out as an independent check (5.4 m).

area_check.basis: The red outline was traced manually from the source raster; the independent similarity fit reproduces the official area within 0.3%, confirming scale and outline identity.

selected_point.basis: pole of inaccessibility of the registered site polygon in JGD2011 plane IX (EPSG:6677)

consistency: Overlaid on the GSI seamless aerial (derived-hino-overlay-photo-z18.png, local only), the registered outline follows the residential lot line on the west, 甲州街道 on the south and the stream-side road on the north-west, and encloses the former west-plant buildings and the cleared demolition area of the Hino Motors plant; the main plant east of the outline is excluded.
independent_checks: The source document states the site is 日野台3丁目1番32,33,34の一部 and 日野台4丁目31番1,2,5 (日野自動車旧西側工場跡地), 114,037.24 m²; the GSI standard map labels the surrounding works 日野自動車工場 and the blocks 日野台三丁目/四丁目.

Hino City's AIGID/MOJ 2026 public-coordinate parcel file (13212, 9,585 features) contains no 日野台3丁目 or 4丁目 parcels, so no registry-map parcel locator is available; GSI chome-level address points are excluded as district-level.
excluded: GSI address-search chome representative points for 日野台三丁目/四丁目
Hino Motors head-office address point (日野台3-1-1)
uncertainty: Control-point RMS 1.6 m and check residual 5.4 m measure registration consistency against the GSI standard map only, not ground accuracy; the manual outline trace and the source raster's 0.66 m pixel add a few metres. The point is chosen for its ~124 m clearance inside the site.

reverification_2026_10_27.script: work/geo/hino_verify.py (uv run --no-project --with pyproj==3.7.1 --with shapely==2.1.1 --with numpy python -I)
reverification_2026_10_27.visual_check: Reduced copy of the japan_east overlay on GSI seamless aerial z18 viewed on 2026-10-27: the red outline follows the residential lot line on the west and 甲州街道 on the south, encloses the former west-plant buildings and the cleared demolition ground, and excludes the Hino Motors main plant to the east; the selected point lies on cleared ground inside it.
